positions.title: Technical Lead - UI
positions.description:
Technical and team lead of 6 software engineers and QA. Focused on driving business value and delivering quality, performance, and exhilarating user experiences. 

Responsible for improving and tuning application performance on a large SPA comprising mainly of React/Redux and various internal SDK frameworks.

Contribution highlights:

Performance Tuning JS and tool building

Designed, architecture, and implemented tooling to efficiently measure application front end performance. This tool measures various application metrics and user interactions, generates reports and graphs, and identified code changes through pull requests that impact performance. The tooling utilizes virtualachines, a custom API caching layer to eliminate BE dependencies, and implements data analytics to demonstrate performance improvements and regressions of any code change in the application. This tooling uses a custom set of injected JS and a controller. This enables 1 millisecond accuracy and helps ensure the performance test timing results are extremely consistent from run to run when using the same hardware. 

The performance tooling I created was also used to tune the application objectively. I was able to performance tune conversation switching that took in average between 1500-30000+ milliseconds down to 10-100 milliseconds. This was a great demonstration of the tool and performance tuning. This means it takes only 0.67% - 0.33% of the original time of the previous release code! Yes those numbers are correct and have been objectively verified with the performance tool.



Performance tuning to reduce server load

Devised, designed, and implemented secure storage of encrypted client keys without requiring Symphony application to host the client private keys. This enables the Symphony application to reduce the load on client hosted key manager servers while keeping the client keys private.

positions.description: Building realtime Node.js rest and socket based applications. Using React, Selenium, Socket.IO, and numerous other technologies to develop multi-user realtime software and document editing tools. Utilizing cloud based hosting including AWS and Azure within a Continuous Delivery software development pipeline to build highly available and scaled applications.

positions.title: Software Developer II
positions.description: Building realtime Node.js rest and socket based applications. Using React, Selenium, Socket.IO, and numerous other technologies to develop multi-user realtime software and document editing tools.

positions.title: Interactive Web Developer - Contract Grant Work
positions.description: Built intricate and interactive interaction utilizing JavaScript, jQuery, CSS and HTML. Interactions were built within various requirements including transforming PSD mockups and wireframes into working jQuery plugins supporting IE6+, Firefox, Chrome, Safari, Mobile Safari, and Android 2.2+ Browser. The interactions that were developed replaced existing Flash interactions or were completely new interactions. Worked directly with Multimedia Designers and Instructional Designers along with personal knowledge of usability and adult learning theories to build interactions that met eLearning developer and learner needs.

honors.title: 2020 Internal Hackathon CEO Award Winner
honors.description: Won the yearly internal hackathon 2nd year in a row. I participated on a team of 2 developers, 1 designer, and 1 product. We won the CEO, Award for building a prototype that implemented secure link unfurling and in browser file preview for PDFs.

honors.title: 2018 Internal Symphony Hackathon Team Winner
honors.description: Won the yearly internal hackathon on a team of 2 developers and 1 product. We won the CEO Award for building a prototype that improved conversation switching by 10x.

projects.title: UL Create
projects.description: Realtime Node.js rest and socket based course authoring  and management application. Application utilizes React, Redux, Webpack, ES6, Selenium, Socket.IO, and numerous other technologies to develop multi-user realtime software and document editing tool. Utilizing cloud based hosting including AWS and in premises infrastructure within a Continuous Delivery software development pipeline to build highly available and scaled application. Deeply integrated course publishing and player tools into UL ComplianceWire LMS and UL ELMS

projects.title: Prezi SCORM
projects.description: PreziSCORM.com is a web tool I created as a weekend project that enables the user to create SCORM packages for public or hidden Prezi presentations. The tool allows the user to simply enter a Prezi ID, URL, or Embed code, and it will create and download a SCORM package for the Prezi. By creating a SCORM package for a Prezi presentation, the Prezi can be used in a Learning Management System (LMS) for tracking progress in eLearning. The tool supports bookmarking and resuming progress in the Prezi presentation. There are a few visual and textual customizations that can be easily set in the tool. The output SCORM packages will run in an LMS that supports SCORM 1.2 and will work in IE8+, Chrome, Firefox, and Safari.
